_comment: IteratedUltimatumGame locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is; do not translate the action tokens [Offer: $X] / [Accept] / [Reject]. Keep the '$' currency symbol and all numbers as-is.

_slots.{pool}: Amount of money available each round (a number)
_slots.{keep}: The amount the proposer keeps (a number)
_slots.{proposer_gain}: Money the proposer gained this round (a number)
_slots.{responder_gain}: Money the responder gained this round (a number)
_slots.{total}: Each player's tied final total (a number)

player_prompt.intro:
O mmoledi {player_id}, o tšama {num_rounds} dikgwedi tša Iterated Ultimatum Game.
O na le $ {pool} go kgatha kgwedi yeo magareng ga wena le mmoledi {other_id}.

Mmoleli wa kgopelo:
  - Dire kgopelo: [Offer: $X] (0 <= X <= pool)
  - Ge e amogetšwe → O amogetša $ (pool - X), mmoledi wa mošate amogetša $X
  - Ge e ganne → Ba amogetša $0
  - Sekhutšo: [Offer: $3]  goba  'Nna ke nagana gore se se lokile. [Offer: $5]'

Mmoleli wa karabo:
  - Tšea kgopelo ka [Accept] goba [Reject]
  - Sekhutšo: 'Se se bonala bjalo ka gore se se lokile. [Accept]'
            'Se se sa lokile. [Reject]'

round.begins:
--- Raundi {round_number} e thoma! ---
Mmadiphoofolo {proposer_id} ke mmadiphoofolo wa mphato, Mmadiphoofolo {responder_id} ke mmadiphoofolo wa karabo.
round.offer: Raundi {round_number}: Mmadiphoofolo {proposer_id} o fa mphato wa $ {offer} go Mmadiphoofolo {responder_id} (a boloka $ {keep}).
round.accepted: Mmoleli {responder_id} o amogetše! Kgwedi {round_number} e amogetša: Mmoleli {proposer_id} +$ {proposer_gain}, mmoleli {responder_id} +$ {responder_gain}. Tšohle tše mpsha: Mmoleli 0: $ {total_0}, mmoleli 1: $ {total_1}.
round.rejected: Mmoleli {responder_id} o ganne kgopelo! Kgwedi {round_number} e amogetša: Ba amogetša $0. Tšohle di sala: Mmoleli 0: $ {total_0}, mmoleli 1: $ {total_1}.

invalid_move.no_offer_format: Mofahloši o swanetše go dira tefelo ka sebopego sa [Offer: $X].
invalid_move.bad_integer: Palo ya tefelo e swanetše go ba palomoka yeo e nepagetšego.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Thekišo e swanetše go ba magareng ga $0 le ${pool}.
invalid_move.no_current_offer: Ga go na seo se lego gona ga bjale sa gore o ka arabela.
invalid_move.accept_or_reject: Mothusi yo a kgonego ya tshegetso ya [Accept] or [Reject] seyo sa tšhelete.

outcome.win: Mothusi {winner} o ile a fenya le ${winner_total} e kgolo go fapana le mothusi {loser} ${loser_total}.
outcome.draw: Bapadi ka bobedi ba feditše le ${total} palomoka.
